task_completion.description: Open the original three-stage rocket file in OpenRocket
task_completion.visual_evidence: OpenRocket application window showing 'three_stage_source.ork' or a rocket with three distinct stages in the component tree.

task_completion.description: Modify the design to have exactly two stages
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket component tree or side-view schematic showing exactly two stages (e.g., Sustainer and Booster) instead of three.

task_completion.description: Ensure the two-stage design includes a nose cone, fins, recovery device, and motors
task_completion.visual_evidence: The component tree listing a Nose Cone, Fin Set, Parachute/Streamer (with deployment event set), and Motor icons/labels in the motor configuration tab.

task_completion.description: Execute a flight simulation to verify the new design
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Flight simulations' tab showing at least one simulation run with a green checkmark or status 'Finished'.

task_completion.description: Save the simplified design to the specified path
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog or terminal command confirming the file is saved as '/home/ga/Documents/rockets/two_stage_simplified.ork'.

task_completion.description: Create the design modification report with all required metrics
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing '/home/ga/Documents/exports/stage_reduction_report.txt' containing the removed stage info, apogee, velocity, and stability margin.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI to modify the rocket design
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with the OpenRocket component tree, motor configuration, or simulation buttons.

integrity.description: The performance data in the report matches the simulation results
integrity.visual_evidence: The apogee and velocity values in the text report match the values displayed in the OpenRocket 'Flight simulations' table.

integrity.description: The report contains specific numerical data, not generic placeholders
integrity.visual_evidence: The report file shows actual numbers (e.g., 'Apogee: 245m') rather than 'TBD' or '[Insert Value]'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source file is 'three_stage_source.ork' (originally a 3-stage design). The target file must be 'two_stage_simplified.ork' and must contain exactly 2 stages. The report must be at '/home/ga/Documents/exports/stage_reduction_report.txt'. A passing score requires a functional design with a stability margin (typically > 1.0 cal) and a recovery deployment event (e.g., 'at apogee').
